mentions.name: Scavenger
mentions.description: This project provides four fully open-source, no-dependency single-file tools that let you export any piece of the web and hotwire it into portable, single-file HTML that works anywhere.
mentions.problem: Good UI found on the web can't be repurposed once you find it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a project that lets you export any piece of web and hotwire it into anything you want on a portable, single-file HTML that works anywhere.

Fully open source, no-deps, four single-file tools.
mentions.author: octantes

mentions.name: Scavenger
mentions.description: This project is a local-first, host-free wiring canvas stored in a single HTML document that can be quined or exported by removing the editor layer; the author's main development focus has been its harvesting feature.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building along the same premise but from the other side (local-first, no host). My document is a wiring canvas that can be quined or exported by removing the editor layer.
mentions.author: octantes
